cohort: The study included 51 women diagnosed with vasa praevia who gave birth between 1st December 2014 and 30th November 2015 in UK obstetrician-led maternity units.
finding: Antenatal diagnosis of vasa praevia, especially in centers with active screening, significantly improves perinatal outcomes by reducing mortality and severe morbidity compared to peripartum diagnosis.
mod_finding: All women with antenatally diagnosed vasa praevia gave birth by planned caesarean section, which was associated with no perinatal deaths or HIE.
cross-section timing: Data collected for births between December 1, 2014, and November 30, 2015.
